mañca: [Maci+a] (pu) CL=7 A bedstead. (A bed frame in which the base is put on legs. Bundikābaddha= The fame and legs are fixed together. Dhāna, Syha. A bed frame that is formed with beams(frame). Pācita, Syha. Kuḷīrapādaka= the leg of a bed frame that is like the leg of a crab. With a bent leg. Āhaccapādaka= a frame of a bedstead that is put on the legs. Vi,2.58. Vi,ṭṭha,3.39. Dhāna. 310).
mañcaaṭanī: [Mañca+aṭanī] (thī) CL=7 The legs of a bed frame.
mañcabhisi: [Mañca+bhisi] (thī) CL=7 A mattress that covers the bed frame.
mañcadāna: [Mañca+dāna] (na) CL=7 An offering of a bed frame.
mañcadāyaka: [Mañca+dāyaka] (pu) CL=7 A Thera named Mañcadāyaka who offered a bed frame.
mañcaka: [Mañca+ka] (pu) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.308.] A bedstead (or) a bed frame. Mañcaka(ti) [mañca+ka] Should be covered on the bed frame. See - Mañcakabhisi.
mañcakabhisi: [Mañcaka+bhisi] (thī) CL=7 A mattress that covers the bed frame.
mañcakadāna: [Mañcaka+dāna] (na) CL=7 Donation of a bed frame.
mañcakapassa: [Mañcaka+passa] (pu) CL=7 The side of a bed frame.
mañcakasivikā: [Mañcaka+sivikā] (thī) CL=7 Making a bed frame or bedstead that is like a stretcher.
mañcantara: [Mañca+antara] (na) CL=7 A special bedstead (or) a different kind of bedstead or bed frame.
mañcapaññāpanapadesa: [Mañcapaññāpana+padesa] (pu) CL=7 A place of setting a bed frame or bedstead.
mañcapaṭipādaka: [Mañca+paṭipādaka] (pu) CL=7 Legs of a bed frame.
mañcappamāṇa: [Mañca+pamāṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) An extent of a bedstead or bed frame. With an extent of a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcapāda: [Mañca+pāda] (pu) CL=7 Legs of a bed frame (or) bedstead.
mañcapādamatthaka: [Mañcapāda+matthaka] (na) CL=7 Above the leg of a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcapādaṭṭhāna: [Mañcapāda+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A place for setting a leg of a bed frame or bedstead.
mañcapīṭhajaggana: [Mañcapīṭha+jaggana]  CL=9 Cleaning the beds and chairs.
mañcapīṭhakavāna: [Mañcapīṭhaka+vāna] (ti) CL=7 (Reed and a piece of cloth) that ties the bed frame together.
mañcapīṭhamaddana: [Mañcapīṭha+maddana] (ti) CL=7 One who destroyed a bed frame (or) bedstead. See also - Pīṭhamaddana-(saṃ,ṭī,2.61).
mañcapīṭhaparibhoga: [Mañcapīṭha+paribhoga] (pu) CL=7 Using a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcapīṭhasambandha: [Mañcapīṭha+sambandha] (ti) CL=7 Related to a bedstead or bed frame. See - Mañcapīṭhasenāsana.
mañcapīṭhasambandhasenāsana: [Mañcapīṭhasambandha+senāsana] (na) CL=7 A sleeping place that is related to a bedstead or bed frame. See - Mañcapīṭhasenāsana.
mañcapīṭhasambandhī: [Mañcapīṭha+sambandhī] (ti) CL=7 Related to a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcapīṭhasenāsana: [Mañcapīṭha+senāsana] (na) CL=7 A bedstead or bed frame that is a sleeping place. The sleeping place that is related to a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcapīṭhasukha: [Mañcapīṭha+sukha] (na) CL=7 The pleasure that arises based on a bedstead or bed frame. A comfortable that is staying on the bedstead or bed frame. The pleasure that is based on a sleeping place which is a bedstead or bed frame. See - Ma, ṭī, 2. 54.
mañcapīṭhavinimutta: [Mañcapīṭha+vinimutta] (ti) CL=7 Without (or) free from a bed frame or bedstead.
mañcapīṭhānuppadāna: [Mañcapīṭha+anuppadāna] (na) CL=7 Giving a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcasahassa: [Mañca+sahassa] (na) CL=7 A thousand bedsteads or bed frames or sleeping places. See - Mañcasata.
mañcasamaññā: [Mañca+samaññā] (thī) CL=7 The name that is bedstead or bed frame or sleeping place.
mañcasamāruḷha: [Mañca+samāruḷha] (ti) CL=7 One who should be placed on a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcasata: [Mañca+sata] (na) CL=7 One hundred bedsteads or bed frames or sleeping places.
mañcasaṅkhepa: [Mañca+saṅkhepa] (pu) CL=7 The shape of a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcasivikā: [Mañca+sivikā] (thī) CL=7 A bedstead or bed frame that is made as a litter or stretcher.
mañcatala: [Mañca+tala] (na) CL=7 The surface of a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcati: [Maci+a+ti] (kri) CL=7 It brings or carries. See - Mañca.
mañcavitthārappamāṇa: [Mañcavitthāra+pamāṇa] (ti) CL=7 It is as long as the width of a bed frame.
mañcavohāra: [Mañca+vohāra] (pu) CL=7 It is called a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcavāṇa: [Mañca+vāṇa] (na) CL=7 A rope that is made of reed strips that ties on a bed frame.
mañcaṅga: [Mañca+aṅga] (pu,na) CL=7 A part (or) component of a bed frame. The bed frame.
mañcaṭṭha: [Mañca+ṭhā+a] (ti) CL=7 One who stayed on the bed frame or bedstead.
mañcaṭṭharukkhasārakasāvaṃ: Mañcaṭṭharukkhasārakasāvaṃ (vimati,1.302) is the word distorted from mañcaṭṭharukkhasārakasāvaṃ. Tipi, 16, 141.
mañcaṭṭhāna: [Mañca+ṭhāna] (na) CL=7 A bedstead or bed frame that is made as a stretcher.
mañcaṭṭhānapariccheda: [Mañcaṭṭhāna+pariccheda] (pu) CL=7 The boundary of a place of a bedstead or bed frame.
mañcopacāra: [Mañca+upacāra] (pu) CL=7 It is called a bedstead or bed frame metaphorically. See - Mañcaṭṭha.
mañcādhāra: [Mañca+ādhāra] (pu) CL=7 The leg of a bed frame. (In Dhāna, Syha, saca, translates a base of a bed frame).
mañcākāra: [Mañca+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 A form of a bedstead or bed frame. The shape of the bed frame.
mañcātimañca: [Mañca+atimañca] (pu) CL=7 A bed frame or bedstead that is placed on another bed frame. a bed frame upon a bed frame. (the stage which has many levels that are called " mañcātimañca" in Pāḷi).
mañjaripūjaka: [Mañjarī+pūjaka] (pu) CL=7 A Thera named Mañjarīpūjaka who makes a devotional offering with garlands.
mañjaritapatta: [Mañjaritā+patta] (ti) CL=7 A spike of grain that is made as a garland.
mañjarī: [Mañcu+ra+ī] (thī) CL=7 [In Dhāna,ṭī.550. Sūci. Chaṭṭhamū, dhāna, ṭī- there is Muñcayoga forest. According to that  -muñca+ra+ī-. Manda+arī. Thoma.] A garland. a bunch of flowers (There are two factors: the stalk with flowers and without flowers, which is called "Mañcarī". Dhāna, ṭī. 550).
mañjaṭṭhika: Mañjaṭṭhika (jā,ṭṭha,7.31) is a distorted word from Mañjaṭṭhika. Tipi,16,141.
mañjaṭṭhirukkhasāra: The words that Mañjaṭṭhirukkhasāra (sārattha,2.373) comes from Ñjaṭṭhirukkhasāra. Tipi,16,141.
mañjaṭṭhī: The words that Mañjaṭṭhī (vi,ṭṭha,2.205. Sārattha,2.373. Vimati,1.302) comes from Mañjaṭṭhī. Tipi,16,141.
mañjerikanāgabhavana: [Mañjerika+nāgabhavana] (na) CL=7 The region of the nāgas is called Mañjerika.
mañjeṭṭha: [Mañjiṭṭhā+ṇa] (ti) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.95.] The color of crimson red dye. The bright red. Ruddy (or) scarlet (color).
mañjeṭṭhaka: [Mañjeṭṭha+ka] (ti) CL=7 The color of crimson red dye. With pure or light red. With Ruddy (or) scarlet (color).
mañjeṭṭhakavaṇṇa: [Mañjeṭṭhaka+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 The color of crimson red dye. With pure or light red. With Ruddy (or) scarlet (color).
mañjeṭṭhavaṇṇa: [Mañjeṭṭha+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 The color of crimson red dye. With pure or light red. With Ruddy (or) scarlet (color)
mañjeṭṭhika: [Mañjeṭṭhā+ika] (ti) CL=7 The color of crimson red dye. With pure or light red. With Ruddy (or) scarlet (color). See - Mañjeṭṭhikavaṇṇa.
mañjeṭṭhikavaṇṇa: [Mañjeṭṭhika+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 The color of crimson red dye. With pure or light red. With Ruddy (or) scarlet (color).
mañjeṭṭhipuppha: [Mañjeṭṭhi+puppha] (ti) CL=7 A flower with a crimson red color.
mañjeṭṭhā: [Maja+ṭha+ā] (thī) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.582. Maji+iṭṭha+ā. Thoma.] (1) A crimson plant that is a kind of shrub from which a red dye is extracted (Morinda citrifolia). (2) A red dye from a shrub plant. See also - Mañjiṭṭhā.
mañjeṭṭhī: [Maja+ṭha+ī] (thī) CL=7 [Maji+iṭṭha+ī] (1) A  crimson plant that is a kind of shrub from which a red dye is extracted (Morinda Cirifolia). (2) Anna, the sixteenth part of a rupee  (that is the currency introduced during British colonial days).
mañjiṭṭha: [Mañjiṭṭhā+ṇa] (ti) CL=7 [Rū,nhā.226.] The cloth that is dyed with crimson red dye. See also - Mañceṭṭha.
mañjiṭṭhaka: [Mañjiṭṭhā+ka] (na) CL=7 (1) The crimson red color. the reddish color or pink color. (Ti) (2) With the crimson red color. With a reddish color or pink color.
mañjiṭṭhakattha: [Mañjiṭṭhaka+attha] (pu) CL=7 The effect of crimson red color.
mañjiṭṭhakavagga: [Mañjiṭṭhaka+vagga] (pu) CL=7 Mañjiṭṭhakavagga. (It is the 4th in 7 Vaggas of Vimānavatthu, In this Vagga includes 12 stories).
mañjiṭṭhakavimāna: [Mañjiṭṭhaka+vimāna] (pu,na) CL=7 The story of a female Deva who lived in Mañjiṭṭhaka mansion. Mañjiṭṭhakavimānavatthu.
mañjiṭṭharasmi: [Mañjiṭṭha+rasmi] (thī) CL=7 Crimson red color (or) pink color.
mañjiṭṭharasmiattha: [Mañjiṭṭharasmi+attha] (pu) CL=7 The effect of crimson red color.
mañjiṭṭharukkhasārakasāva: [Mañjiṭṭharukkhasāra+kasāva] (pu,na) CL=7 A red dye that is extracted from the heart of the Indian Mulberry plant  (Morinda citrifolia).
mañjiṭṭhavaṇṇa: [Mañjiṭṭha+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 Has a crimson-red color. Has the color of jack fruit creeper. See also - Syha. 339. Mañciṭṭhika.
mañjiṭṭhika: [Mañjiṭṭhā+ika] (ti) CL=7 [Mañjiṭṭhī+ka.] It is a crimson-red color.
mañjiṭṭhikavaddhika: [Mañjiṭṭhika+vaddhika] (ti) CL=7 Equipped with crimson-red color thongs (or) straps.
mañjiṭṭhikā: [Mañjiṭṭhī+ka+ā] (thī) CL=7 (1) Plant disease which turns the inside of the plant red. (This disease causes the intestine to be a crimson-red color). (2) A red dye that is extracted from the heart of the Indian Mulberry plant.
mañjiṭṭhirukkhasāra: [Mañjiṭṭhirukkha+sāra] (pu) CL=7 The heart of the Indian Mulberry plant (Morinda citrifolia). See - Mañjiṭṭhī.
mañjiṭṭhā: [Maja+ṭha+ā] (thī) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.582.(mañjiṭṭhā-saṃ)maji+ippa+ā. Thoma. Itthijotaka āpaccaññaḥ If relates Itthijotaka āpaccaya, is Mañjiṭṭhā, if relates Īpaccaya, is Mañjiṭṭhī. Nirutti, nhā. 59.] (1) An Indian Mulberry plant (Morinda citrifolia). (2) A crimson-red dye. (2) The crimson-red color. Reddish color. Mañjiṭṭha aureole. Dark-red aureole. (This color is explained as the color of red flowers of the Rhododendron plant in the sermons). See also - Mañjiṭṭharasmi, mañjeṭṭhā.
mañjiṭṭhī: [Maja+ṭha+ī] (thī) CL=7 [Maji+iṭṭha+ī.] (1) The Indian Mulberry plant (Morinda citrifolia). (2) The crimson-red dye.
mañju: [Mana+ju] (ti) CL=7 [Mana+ranja+u. Mana+ju+a. Dhāna,ṭī.129,692-6. Moga,7.46.] (1) Charming. (2) One who is speaking sweetly.
mañjubhāṇaka: [Mañju+bhaṇa+ṇvu] (ti) CL=7 [In Thī mañjubhāṇakā] One who has sweet-voiced. One who is speaking sweetly.
mañjubhāṇī: [Mañju+bhaṇa+ṇī] (ti) CL=7 One who has sweet-voiced.One who is speaking sweetly.
mañjuka: [Mañju+ka] (ti) CL=7 One who is speaking sweetly.
mañjuruta: [Mañju+ruta] (ti) CL=7 One who is speaking sweetly (or) cried sweetly.
mañjusagopana: [Mañjusā+gopana] (na) CL=7 It is put in the box to be safe.
mañjussara: [Mañju+sara] (ti) CL=7 One who has a sweet voice.
mañjusā: [Mana+sa] (thī) CL=7 [Mana+saka. Manañāṇe, so, ju majjho. Dhāna,ṭī.524. Manissajuka, maññati sadhanattaṃ etāyāti mañjūsā=kaṭṭhapeḷā. Moga,7.215.] A box. A casket.
mañjusāgopana: [Mañjusā+gopana] (na) CL=7 It puts in the box to be safe.
mañjāra: [Maja+āra] (pu) CL=7 [Dhāna,ṭī.615. In Thī mañcārī. See - Toṅapokadhānasyha for Majjāra, Mañcārapuda]. A cat. See also - Majjāra.
mañjārakkhimaṇḍalavaṇṇa: [Mañjārakkhimaṇḍala+vaṇṇa] (ti) CL=7 The appearance is like a cat"s eye.
mañjāramaṇi: [Mañjāra+maṇi] (pu,na) CL=7 Cat"s eye gem. See - Mañjārakkhimaṇḍalavaṇṇa.
mañjūsakarukkha: [Mañjūsaka+rukkha] (pu) CL=7 A celestial tree. See - Mañjūsakarukkhamūla.
mañjūsakarukkhamūla: [Mañjūsakarukkha+mūla] (na) CL=7 The base of a celestial tree.
mañjūsā: [Mana+sa] (thī) CL=7 [Mana+saka. Manañāṇe, so, ju majjho. Dhāna,ṭī.524. Manissajuka, maññati sādhanattaṃ etāyāti mañjūsā=kaṭṭhapeḷā. Moga,7.215.] A box. A casket.
maññana: [Mana+ya+yu] (thī,na) CL=7 Imagination. Thinking. A cause of imagination. A cause of thinking.
maññanalakkhaṇa: [Maññanā+lakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 Has the characteristic of imagination.
maññanamāna: [Maññanā+māna] (pu) CL=7 A pride that happens due to illusion. See - Atimāna-mahāni, ṭṭha. 180.
maññanattha: [Maññanā+attha] (pu) CL=7 (1) Meaning of imagination. (Ti) (2) Has the meaning of imagination.
maññanta: [Mana+ya+anta] (ti) CL=7 One who is thinking. (A) One who is an illusion. (B) One who is proud.
maññanti: [Mana+ya+anti] (kri) CL=7 They think. They consider. See - Maññati-(2).
maññantu: [Mana+ya+antu] (kri) CL=7 They will think (or) imagine. See - Maññati-(2).
maññanā: [Mana+ya+yu+ā] (thī) CL=7 Imagination. Thinking. Thinking highly of oneself (or) illusion. (Maññanā that means illusion. Happens Vipallāsa dhamma due to Avijjā. Happens illusion (or) thinking highly of oneself due to  Vipallāsa dhamma). See original.
maññanādūsita: [Maññanā+dūsita]  CL=9 Spoiled- ill-treated by the Maññanā Dhamma.
maññanāhetuka: [Maññanā+hetu+ka] (ti) CL=7 Has the root cause that is an illusion. See - Maññanāhetu.
maññanākicca: [Maññanā+kicca] (na) CL=7 The matter (or) function of illusion.
maññanāmūlaka: [Maññanā+mūla+ka] (ti) CL=7 That is the root cause of Maññanā dhamma.
maññanānukūla: [Maññanā+anukūla] (ti) CL=7 Suitable for the illusion (or) imagination. See - Maññanā.
maññanāpaṭikkhepa: [Maññanā+paṭikkhepa] (pu) CL=7 Rejection of the imagination (or) illusion.
maññanāpaṭisedhaka: [Maññanā+paṭisedhaka] (ti) CL=7 It prevents the imagination (or) illusion.
maññanāpaṭisedhanasamattha: [Maññanā+paṭisedhanasamattha] (ti) CL=7 Ability to prevent illusion (or) imagination.
maññanāsahita: [Maññanā+sahita] (ti) CL=7 It happens together with illusion or imagination. See - Maññanānukūla.
maññanāttaya: [Maññanā+taya] (na) CL=7 A group of three factors of illusion or imagination. See - Maññanā.
maññanāvatthu: [Maññanā+vatthu] (na) CL=7 An object of a located place of illusion or imagination.
maññanāvatthudassana: [Maññanāvatthu+dassana] (na) CL=7 Showing an object of a located place of illusion or imagination.
maññanāvatthuvibhāga: [Maññanāvatthu+vibhāga] (pu) CL=7 Criticizes the object of a located place of illusion or imagination.
maññanāvibhāgadassana: [Maññanāvibhāga+dassana] (na) CL=7 Showing a state of criticism of illusion or imagination.
maññanāvidhi: [Maññanā+vidhi] (pu) CL=7 The way of causing illusion or imagination.
maññanāyojanā: [Maññanā+yojanā] (thī) CL=7 Yoking (or) connecting with the action of illusion or imagination.
maññasi: [Mana+ya+si] (kri) CL=7 (1) You know. See - Maññati-(1). (2) You think. See - Maññati-(2).
maññassava: [Mañña+assava] (pu) CL=7 The outflow of thought. The tide of imagination.
maññata: [Mana+ya+ta] (na) CL=7 [In Ṭī  there is mayatā]. Thinking with Taṇhā māna diṭṭhi. See - Maññita.
maññatha: [Mana+ya+tha] (kri) CL=7 (1) You (pl) know. See - Maññati-(1). (2) You (pl) consider. See - Maññati-(2). Maññatha(kri) [mana+ya+ā. Ā-kiu Tha-pru.] He has imagined. See - Maññati - (2).
maññati: [Mana+ya+ti] (kri) CL=7 [Rū,nhā.310. Manamaññanāyaṃ, maññati. Nirutti,nhā.444.] (1) He knows. He thinks. He considers. See original.
maññe: [Mana+ya+mi] (kri) CL=7 (1) I know. See - Maññati-(1). (2) I think, See - Maññati-(2). Maññe(kri) [mana+ya+ma. Ma changes to e-.] We think, See - Maññati-(2). Maññe (Bya). (1) I think. (2) Translates 'as or like' in  Upamājotakanipāta.
maññetha: [Mana+ya+etha] (kri) CL=7 You (pl) should think. See - Maññati-(2).
maññeyya: [Mana+ya+eyyaṃ] (kri) CL=7 I will think. See - Maññati-(2).
maññeyyaṃ: [Mana+ya+eyyaṃ] (kri) CL=7 I will think. See - Maññati-(2).
maññeyyuṃ: [Mana+ya+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They should think. See - Maññati-(2).
maññeyyāsi: [Mana+ya+eyyāsi] (kri) CL=7 You should think. See - Maññati-(2).
maññeyyātha: [Mana+ya+eyyātha] (kri) CL=7 You (pl) should think. See - Maññati-(2).
maññi: [Mana+ya+ī] (kri) CL=7 He thought. See - Maññati-(1). Maññi(kri) [mana+ya+o. O-change to i-.] He imagined. See - Maññati(2).
maññisaṃ: [Mana+ya+ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 [Cancel one sa due to Chanaḥ]. I will be thought. See - Maññati(2).
maññissanti: [Mana+ya+ssanti] (kri) CL=7 They will think. See - Maññati(2).
maññissasi: [Mana+ya+ssasi] (kri) CL=7 You will imagine, See - Maññati(2).
maññissati: [Mana+ya+ssati] (kri) CL=7 You will think. See - Maññati(2).
maññissaṃ: [Mana+ya+ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 [Rū,nhā.281.] I will think. See -  maññati-(2).
maññissāma: [Mana+ya+ssāma] (kri) CL=7 We will think. See - Maññati-(2).
maññita: [Mana+ya+ta] (na) CL=7 (1) Thinking (or) imagination. (See - Maññanā for three factors of Maññita). (2) Thinking highly of oneself. Pride. (See - Mānā for nine factors of Maññita). (Ti) (3) Thinking highly of oneself (or) having pride. (4) One who is imagination or illusion.
maññitabba: [Mana+ya+tabba] (ti) CL=7 (1) Should know. (2) Should think. Maññitabba(ti) [māna+ya+tabba. Nirutti,nhā.461. Rū,nhā.389.] One who should be cherished and worshiped by others. See - Māniya.
maññitabbaṭṭha: [Maññitabba+attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of imagination (or) illusion.
maññitappaccanīka: [Maññita+paccanīka] (pu) CL=7 The opposite status of illusion.
maññitavibhāga: [Maññita+vibhāga] (pu) CL=7 Criticizes the state of imagination or illusion.
maññittha: [Mana+ya+ttha] (kri) CL=7 You (pl) become proud. See - Maññati-(2). Maññittha(kri) [mana+ya+ā] (1) He knows. See - Maññati(1). (2) He thinks. See - Maññati(2).
maññitākāra: [Maññita+ākāra] (pu) CL=7 The way or manner of thinking.
maññiṃsu: [Mana+ya+uṃ] (kri) CL=7 (1) They know. See - Maññati-(1). (2) They thought. See - Maññati-(2).
mañcaṭṭharukkhasārakasāva: Mañcaṭṭharukkhasārakasāvaṃ (vimati,1.302) is the word distorted from mañcaṭṭharukkhasārakasāvaṃ. Tipi, 16, 141.
maññeyyu: [Mana+ya+eyyuṃ] (kri) CL=7 They should think. See - Maññati-(2).
maññisa: [Mana+ya+ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 [Cancel one sa due to Chanaḥ]. I will be thought. See - Maññati(2).
maññissa: [Mana+ya+ssaṃ] (kri) CL=7 [Rū,nhā.281.] I will think. See -  maññati-(2).
maññisu: [Mana+ya+uṃ] (kri) CL=7 (1) They know. See - Maññati-(1). (2) They thought. See - Maññati-(2).
